task: design storefront to hub order flow with an outbox on the storefront and a receiver on the hub

roles.name: hub-order-contract-mapper
roles.mission: Map the hub order contract fields the storefront outbox must send
acceptance: every hub order contract field the storefront outbox must send is named

roles.name: storefront-outbox-designer
roles.mission: Design the storefront outbox table, trigger, and drain schedule
acceptance: the outbox design covers the table, trigger, and drain schedule

roles.name: hub-receiver-designer
roles.mission: Design the hub receiver signature check, dedupe, and reapply path
acceptance: the receiver design covers the signature check, dedupe, and reapply path

roles.name: storefront-hub-design-merger
roles.mission: Merge the outbox and receiver designs into one storefront to hub order flow
acceptance: the merged design carries every hub order contract field and no unresolved conflict between the outbox and receiver designs

roles.name: hub-contract-conformance-checker
roles.mission: Check the merged storefront hub design against the hub order contract
criteria: every hub order contract field is sent by the outbox
the receiver rejects an unsigned order
